title: Cedar Skewers with Ukrainian Spices
description: A unique blend of Indian and Ukrainian flavors in a flavorful skewer dish. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Cedar Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soaked in water for 30 minutes before use

ingredients.name: Ukrainian Spice Blend (caraway, cumin, coriander, dill, mustard, black pepper)
Teque Pepper
ingredients.notes: or substitute with red chili flakes

instructions: Soak the cedar skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before use.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the Ukrainian Spice Blend, Teque Pepper, lime juice, garlic, and ginger.
Add the crispy onions, chopped cilantro, and salt to the bowl. Mix well.
Thread the skewers with the onion-cilantro mixture, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the coconut oil on the skewers.
Place the skewers on the preheated grill.
Cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the skewers are nicely charred.
